name: Rezin
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: In those days the Most High begins to send Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah against Judah.

note.label: 2 Kings 15: The Kings of a Divided House

points: Rezin king of Syria and Pekah king of Israel come up to war against Jerusalem and besiege Ahaz but cannot overcome him.

note.label: 2 Kings 16: Ahaz and the Altar of Damascus

points: In the days of Ahaz, son of Jotham, son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel went up toward Jerusalem to war, but could not prevail against it.

note.label: Isaiah 7: Ahaz, the Confederacy, and the Sign of Immanuel

points: Isaiah was to say, "Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted," for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria and of Remaliah's son.

note.label: Isaiah 7: Ahaz, the Confederacy, and the Sign of Immanuel

points: Ephraim allied with Syria against Judah. The head of Syria is Damascus and the head of Damascus is Rezin, and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people. That is who Moses meant by 'not a people.'

note.label: The Dividing Hatred: the Grafted in Strangers

points: Therefore the Most High shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him and join his enemies together, the Syrians before and the Philistines behind, and they shall devour Israel with open mouth.

note.label: Isaiah 9: For Unto Us a Child Is Born
